description: The file defines an Android Fragment named HomeFragment which serves as the main home screen for a TV app. It manages UI components such as a top navigation Compose view, hero banner, 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels' rails, handles focus navigation, and observes ViewModel data states to populate the UI. The code includes layout setup, focus management, data loading, and UI update methods.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment implementing the main home screen with focusable UI components, data loading via ViewModel, and focus navigation tailored for Android TV.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Sets up root view hierarchy, adds Compose top navigation bar, hero banner, and content rails, and manages focus navigation setup.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Requests initial focus, sets up observers, loads data.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Restores focus to navigation bar when returning to the fragment.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes LiveData from ViewModel and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading UI for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading UI for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading UI for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading UI for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message with retry prompt.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the Continue Watching rail with data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV channels rail with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds the Compose top navigation bar with initial focus and key event handling.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Initializes the hero banner section with a hero card and focus routing.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Initializes the Continue Watching section with title, loading indicator, and horizontal list.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Initializes the TV Channels section similarly.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focusability for the content rails.
